thread:
Maya (PM): Heads-up — competitor just announced self-serve routing + cheap quantized endpoints. saw the blog: https://example.com/quickserve :eyes:
Alex (Eng): saw it. rough parity on routing controls, but their latency claims are vague.
Pat (Data): they're pushing cheaper token pricing for batch/embeds. might undercut our mid-market play.
Jess (Design): product pages already updated, looks like an easy narrative for them: 'low-cost inference'.
Maya (PM): need a quick decision: do we 1) fast-follow with a lite-routing product, 2) lean into differentiators (reliability/rollouts), or 3) price-match for hosted?
Alex (Eng): engineering-wise a "lite-routing" MVP is doable in one sprint if we reduce scope: prefix-only cache + simple per-tenant throttles.
Pat (Data): price-match is political — finance won't love it unless we can offset w/ quantization suggestions.
Jess (Design): landing experience for lite-routing must clarify tradeoffs: cheaper but no per-route SLOs.
Maya (PM): ok trade matrix: speed-to-market, risk, $ impact. I'll sketch a one-pager.
Alex (Eng): rough dev tasks:
```
- add tenant flag: lite_routing_enabled
- cache: prefix-only
- throttle: basic token-based limiter
- telemetry: differentiator tags
```
Pat (Data): telemetry is critical — if we launch cheaper tier w/out tracking, we won't know if quality regresses. add eval hooks.
Jess (Design): can we reuse existing pricing page templates? need copy: "Cheaper tier for experimental workloads — best-effort latency"
Maya (PM): launch criteria proposal:
- E2E e2e latency P50 < 300ms for 90% of requests
- telemetry: prompt-level quality sampling + alerting on regressed prompts
- docs + pricing page ready
- canary: 5% traffic for first week
Alex (Eng): canary config: set in rollout service: `rollout.set(tenant, 0.05, variant='lite')`
Pat (Data): add a rollback rule based on BLEU/ROUGE drop > 2% on core prompt set or error rate > 0.5%
Maya (PM): good. Tradeoffs: this MVP won't have per-route SLOs or advanced batching. we should call those out in docs.
Jess (Design): UI microcopy: include "no guaranteed throughput" + "can be switched off for safety" lines.
Alex (Eng): estimate: 2 engineers 2 weeks to get core + canary pipeline. plus 1 day infra prep.
Maya (PM): cost/price idea: 30% discount vs standard hosted for token+embed combos. finance ok?
Pat (Data): set an experiment id and track: `experiment=lite-routing-q3` in telemetry events.
release-bot: deploy scheduled: staging rollout at 2023-11-08T15:00Z (auto-notify) :white_check_mark:
Maya (PM): action items:
- Maya: publish one-pager and decision by EOD today
- Alex: prototype flags + canary hooks (WIP)
- Pat: eval hook + experiment tracking
- Jess: pricing microcopy + docs stub
Maya (PM): if we decide to price-match, we'll need a separate finance sign-off thread. For now leaning to 1) lite-routing MVP + explicit differentiator comms.
Alex (Eng): agree — lower-risk and retains our reliability message.
Pat (Data): I'll draft the eval thresholds and add to SLO runbook.
Jess (Design): I'll drop a copy draft in #design-review in 2 hours.
Maya (PM): thanks all. ping me if blocker. :thumbsup:
